application-container.description: PROot Ubuntu and managed application runtime.
application-container.name: Application-container boundary

browser.description: User device, browser, PWA, and safe local frontend state.
browser.name: Browser trust boundary

control-api.description: FastAPI validation, side-effect-free reads, and command admission.
control-api.name: Control API boundary

durable-state.description: SQLite canonical state, indexes, revisions, and prepared projections.
durable-state.name: Durable-state boundary

external-release.description: GitHub source and immutable release assets.
external-release.name: External release boundary

messaging-execution.description: NATS/JetStream, workers, subprocesses, queues, and lifecycle execution.
messaging-execution.name: Messaging and execution boundary

server-host.description: Android/Termux or Ubuntu host processes and local networking.
server-host.name: Server-host boundary

agent-command-executor.name: Device command executor
agent-command-executor.responsibility: Executes approved device commands in the node agent and publishes truthful results.

agent-recovery.name: Reconnect watchdog and supervisor recovery
agent-recovery.responsibility: Separates running-but-disconnected recovery from stopped-agent recovery and exposes truthful guidance when no supervisor is available.

agent-signals.name: Heartbeat, telemetry, and health publishers
agent-signals.responsibility: Publish fresh runtime signals used to derive Online, Offline, Stale, Agent stopped, and Remote access not ready states.

agent-supervisor.name: Lite agent supervisor
agent-supervisor.responsibility: Runs separately from the agent, reads the protected agent environment, and starts or restarts failed agents without overwriting identity.

api-domain-surfaces.name: Fleet, Apps, Security, Recovery, and Release APIs
api-domain-surfaces.responsibility: Exposes domain-specific read and command endpoints while preserving backend-owned lifecycle execution.

api-guards.data_owner: SQLite human identity/session state plus device identity and invite state
api-guards.name: Identity, authentication, and invite guards
api-guards.responsibility: Applies human authentication/session/CSRF guards plus device identity, duplicate, protected-host, and fail-closed invite/bootstrap acceptance guards.

api-read-surfaces.name: Prepared read, health, readiness, diagnostics, and evidence APIs
api-read-surfaces.responsibility: Serves side-effect-free prepared projections, health/readiness, compact diagnostics, and sanitized evidence lookups.

app-catalog.name: App Catalog
app-catalog.responsibility: Presents backend-owned app lifecycle and safe action readiness, including same-origin Open routes and Manage details.

app-lifecycle-worker.name: App lifecycle worker
app-lifecycle-worker.responsibility: Owns install, repair, media import, backup, restore preview, update readiness/apply, and removal paths only where implemented and safe.

app-recovery-update.name: App backup, restore preview, and update lifecycle
app-recovery-update.responsibility: Coordinates app backup, safe restore preview, update readiness/apply, verification, and rollback gates without browser-owned execution.

app-workflow-state.name: App, command, and workflow state
app-workflow-state.responsibility: Stores canonical app current/action lifecycle and workflow command/current/event state.

atomic-promotion.name: Atomic PWA promotion
atomic-promotion.responsibility: Promotes a verified staged PWA atomically and keeps the previous release available for rollback.

backup-engine.name: Backup and verification engine
backup-engine.responsibility: Creates and verifies local encrypted backups through backend/worker-owned operations.

bounded-reconciliation.name: Bounded queues and reconciliation
bounded-reconciliation.responsibility: Bounds admission, coalesces low-value work, reconciles queue depth, and prevents unrelated lifecycle deletion.

browser.name: Browser
browser.responsibility: Hosts the installed or web PWA and enforces browser-origin boundaries.

caddy.name: Caddy same-origin proxy
caddy.responsibility: Serves the PWA and routes /api/lite/* and managed app paths without exposing backend secrets.

checkpoints-retention.name: Checkpoints and retention policy
checkpoints-retention.responsibility: Creates pre-change checkpoints and applies explicit bounded retention without silently deleting current state.

command-lifecycle.name: Command admission and lifecycle
command-lifecycle.responsibility: Tracks admission, queued, claimed, running, terminal, acknowledgement, retry, and dead-letter behavior independently from device lifecycle.

completion-evidence.data_owner: SQLite evidence index and sanitized files
completion-evidence.name: Completion and audit evidence
completion-evidence.responsibility: Records sanitized lifecycle and completion evidence for commands, devices, apps, security, recovery, and releases.

device-state.name: Enrollment and device lifecycle state
device-state.responsibility: Retains enrolled devices across connectivity loss and separates durable enrollment, current state, health, supervisor state, and recovery history.

frontend-state.data_owner: FastAPI; Dexie is safe read-only fallback
frontend-state.name: Frontend state ownership
frontend-state.responsibility: Combines service worker, TanStack Query, Dexie safe snapshots, Zustand UI-only state, XState guided flows, API client, error boundaries, and generated fixtures without owning backend truth.

github-release.name: GitHub Release
recovery_paths: do not apply; publish corrected release
github-release.responsibility: Publishes the verified Lite release manifest, checksums, and dist.zip assets for the release subprocess.

github-repository.name: GitHub repository
github-repository.responsibility: Hosts source and release workflow definitions; it is not a Lite runtime apply owner.

invite-state.name: Invite and identity lifecycle
invite-state.responsibility: Tracks pending, accepted, revoked, blocked, and consumed invite/identity state with duplicate and mismatch guards.

lan.name: Local LAN
lan.responsibility: Provides local-device access to the same-origin Caddy endpoint without hardcoded addresses.

last-known-good.data_owner: Release SQLite state and prior PWA
last-known-good.name: Last-known-good state and rollback
last-known-good.responsibility: Records the verified prior release and restores it atomically when post-switch validation fails.

lite-api.name: FastAPI /api/lite/*
lite-api.responsibility: Validates requests, owns safe read APIs, admits commands, and never delegates browser execution directly to NATS or shell.

media-app-health.name: Media readiness and app health probes
media-app-health.responsibility: Verifies approved media mapping, base-path route health, and app readiness without scanning or exposing user media in documentation.

nats-jetstream.name: NATS / JetStream
nats-jetstream.responsibility: Provides the command and event backbone with durable delivery; it is never contacted directly by the frontend.

nats-listeners.name: Primary and secondary NATS listeners
nats-listeners.responsibility: Exposes local and verified Tailnet-reachable NATS listeners for agents without hardcoding credentials or addresses.

node-agent.data_owner: Local identity environment; server SQLite is canonical
node-agent.name: Lite node agent
node-agent.responsibility: Connects to NATS, publishes heartbeat/telemetry/health, handles device commands, and reconnects after outages.

identity-access-controls.data_owner: SQLite passkey, session-assurance, Enterprise configuration, and membership state
identity-access-controls.name: Passkey, step-up, and Enterprise identity controls
identity-access-controls.responsibility: Verifies passkeys, records purpose-bound session assurance, and resolves server-owned Enterprise memberships and final-Owner protection; it does not create a browser-held authority.

opa-policy-engine.data_owner: Repository Rego source and bounded SQLite policy decision metadata
opa-policy-engine.name: OPA Safety Rules policy engine
opa-policy-engine.recovery_owner: Startup validation and PM2 core supervisor
opa-policy-engine.responsibility: Evaluates only registered protected actions after FastAPI hard invariants and before existing NATS/worker execution; it never owns command execution.

photoprism.name: PhotoPrism
photoprism.responsibility: Provides the verified managed photo application under a same-origin Caddy path.

pm2.name: PM2 process manager
pm2.responsibility: Starts and supervises approved server-host and joined-device processes with bounded restart policies.

post-switch-health.name: Post-switch health validation
post-switch-health.responsibility: Validates Caddy/FastAPI/PWA health after promotion before declaring the release current.

prepared-state.name: Audit index, projection refresh, prepared projections, and domain revisions
prepared-state.responsibility: Indexes audit evidence and tracks dirty signals, generations, committed projections, current-state summaries, and semantic revisions.

projection-subprocesses.name: Projection subprocesses
projection-subprocesses.responsibility: Own CPU-heavy projection reconstruction and serialization outside the API process.

proot-ubuntu.name: PROot Ubuntu application container
proot-ubuntu.responsibility: Hosts verified applications such as PhotoPrism without making documentation tooling or the browser a runtime dependency.

pwa.name: React / Vite PWA
pwa.responsibility: Renders Lite screens and sends same-origin requests only to FastAPI through Caddy.

recovery-state.name: Backup, restore, and checkpoint state
recovery-state.responsibility: Stores backup manifests, recovery operations, current state, database backups/restores, and restore checkpoints.

release-artifacts.name: Date-based Lite tag, dist.zip, checksums, and release manifest
release-artifacts.responsibility: Defines immutable release identity and the exact assets required for a Lite installation.

release-staging.data_owner: Staging directory and release SQLite state
release-staging.name: Download staging and release verification
release-staging.responsibility: Downloads on explicit/manual or stable cadence, verifies repository/tag/manifest/assets/checksums, and stages without touching the active PWA.

release-state.name: Installed release and runtime state
release-state.responsibility: Stores installed-release identity and release-runtime projection for truthful comparison, staging, apply, rollback, and last-known-good state.

release-subprocess.data_owner: SQLite release state and staging area
release-subprocess.name: Release subprocess
release-subprocess.responsibility: Owns network, download, verification, staging, apply, and rollback work outside the FastAPI event loop.

remote-readiness.name: Remote-access readiness checks
outputs: Ready or Remote access not ready
recovery_paths: safe startup side effects outside reads
remote-readiness.responsibility: Combines tailscaled state, Tailnet IPv4, NATS listener reachability, agent/supervisor status, and safe guidance.

restore-preview.name: Restore preview and confirmed restore
restore-preview.responsibility: Builds a non-destructive preview, requires explicit confirmation, creates a checkpoint, applies restore, and validates health.

retirement-database-recovery.name: Explicit retirement and database recovery
retirement-database-recovery.responsibility: Requires assessment and confirmation for device retirement and provides verified database backup/preview/restore without coupling command cleanup to device deletion.

scanner-adapters.name: Lynis and Trivy scanner adapters
scanner-adapters.responsibility: Run bounded backend-owned scanners with target-aware exclusions and sanitized evidence; the browser never executes scanners.

security-coordinator.name: Security scan coordinator
security-coordinator.responsibility: Validates Quick, Full, and App Check requests, tracks active runs, and exposes compact split-read summaries.

security-profiles.name: Quick, Full, and App safety checks
security-profiles.responsibility: Defines bounded profile-specific targets, exclusions, timeouts, coverage summaries, and truthful partial/failed states.

security-state.name: Security findings and run state
security-state.responsibility: Stores scan runs, tools, progress, findings, profile snapshots, and sanitized evidence references.

sqlite.name: SQLite control-plane store
sqlite.responsibility: Stores canonical Lite lifecycle state and prepared projections; the frontend never accesses it directly.

tailscale.name: Tailscale remote access
tailscale.responsibility: Provides private Tailnet connectivity and HTTPS identity without becoming a browser-held secret or control owner.

tailscaled.name: tailscaled daemon
tailscaled.responsibility: Owns Tailscale networking; startup scripts may detect/start it safely while read APIs remain side-effect-free.

worker.responsibility: Consumes durable commands and owns backend execution for apps, security, recovery, releases, and lifecycle work.

workflow-execution.name: Workflow execution
workflow-execution.responsibility: Coordinates multi-step workflow state through bounded event admission and process-isolated projection work.
